reason: This is a broad planner-core refactor, not a narrow local fix. Even if the intent is removing indirection, it touches central optimizer/runtime wiring across physical plan generation, logical selection, sort/window/expand operators, cascades memo, index resolution, and plan-to-PB translation. Changes in these paths can silently alter plan construction or optimizer behavior across many query shapes, so it is central and risky enough for a focused Blocker/High review.
